## Assumptions made in this run

1. **A `rooms` table is staged here.** The request moves existing title deeds into one bootstrap room, and
   the repo has no `rooms` table. Pairs 1 and 2 create the smallest one (`id`, `created_at`) and insert the
   room. If the `lobby` rooms prerequisite lands first, drop pair 1 and keep pair 2.
2. **`properties.room_id` has no foreign key to `rooms`.** Contexts hold no foreign keys into each other's
   tables (`properties.owner_id` has none; `docs/features/board-property.md`, Decisions). The same holds for
   the player and title deed ids in the `trades` tables.
3. **Step 5 sweeps late rows.** Its copy puts a title deed that still has no room into the bootstrap room,
   so a row inserted between steps 4 and 5 does not stop the app at start.
4. **Step 5 keeps the three `CHECK` constraints of `properties`.** Dropping them would change behaviour
   nobody asked to change.

## Convention divergences

| Course default | This repo | What was written |
|---|---|---|
| timestamp file names, `.up.sql` + `.down.sql` | `NNNN_<context>_<name>.sql`, forward-only; the runner rejects other names | staged files use the course names; the live names are in the table above; `.down.sql` files stay in the feature folder |
| `UUID`, `TIMESTAMPTZ`, `VARCHAR(N)` | SQLite: `TEXT`, `INTEGER` | SQLite types; string bounds stay in the JSON schemas and the domain |
| `created_at ... DEFAULT now()` | timestamps are ISO strings from the app clock, which tests control (sad.md §8, QG-3) | `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`, no default. The bootstrap room row has a fixed time, like its id |
| UUID v7 primary keys | `randomUUID()` (v4) in the service (sad.md §8) | `TEXT` ids, generated by the service. The bootstrap room id is the fixed v7-shaped literal |
| surrogate id and `created_at` on every table | — | `trade_offer_properties` has a composite primary key and no `created_at`: its rows are part of an offer |
| `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` on existing tables | SQLite has none; migrations run at start, each in one transaction | plain `CREATE INDEX` |
| `ALTER ... SET NOT NULL` as step 3 | SQLite cannot alter a column | table rebuild in step 5 |
| no `CHECK` | `players` and `properties` use `CHECK` | none in the new tables; the existing three are carried through the rebuild |
| index on every foreign key | — | the one foreign key, `trade_offer_properties.offer_id`, is the first column of the primary key |

## Breaking change decomposed

`properties.room_id NOT NULL` → pairs 3, 4, 5 (expand, backfill, contract), with
`migrations/backfill-room_id.md`. Each is a separate promotion. Pair 5 is the breaking one: after it an
insert without `room_id` fails.

## Drift findings

**Schema vs source.**

| Finding | Where | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| column without field: `properties.room_id` | `src/board/domain/property.ts` (`Property`), `src/board/infra/sqlite/propertyRepo.ts` (`toProperty`, `insert`) | code, with pair 3: add `roomId`, write it on insert. Not a migration, so nothing is staged under `_drift/` |
| insert without `room_id` | `propertyRepo.ts`, `insert` statement | must change before pair 5; otherwise `POST /properties` fails |
| no source yet | `src/trades/`, rooms in `src/lobby/` | written by `implement-tasks` |

The schema of `migrations/0001`–`0003` matches the `Player` and `Property` types as they are today.

**Model vs spec.**

No table lacks an origin in the PRD or the SAD. `sad.md` has no ER section; relationships were taken from
§5 and the §6 flows.

## Self-check

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Naming | pass: plural snake_case tables, `<timestamp>_<verb>_<entity>` files |
| Down reverses up | pass, run on `node:sqlite` 3.50.4: live `0001`–`0003`, then 7 ups, then 7 downs; tables, columns, indexes and rows equal the start. The rebuild leaves the stored DDL text of `properties` re-quoted and re-wrapped; its content is the same |
| Foreign key indexes | pass: `offer_id` leads the primary key |
| Forbidden features | 6 hits, all carried over: the three `CHECK` constraints of `properties` in `20261117083004_set_properties_room_id_not_null.up.sql` lines 8–10 and `.down.sql` lines 5–7. No new `CHECK`, no trigger, no business default |

Also checked in the same run: after pair 5 an insert without `room_id` is refused, the name index and the
`CHECK` constraints still work, a row inserted between pairs 4 and 5 ends in the bootstrap room, the
idempotent files can run twice, and each of the three reads in sad.md §6 uses its index.

The ER diagram was checked by the structural lint; `mmdc` is not installed.
